def restore_payloads(path, features, output):
    expected = {archive_name(r["path"]): r for r in features["checked_inputs"]
                if ("benchmarks", "results") in list(zip(PurePosixPath(r["path"]).parts,
                                                        PurePosixPath(r["path"]).parts[1:]))}
    require(len(expected) == 183, "Incomplete retained payload inventory")
    ancestors = {str(parent) for name in expected for parent in PurePosixPath(name).parents
                 if str(parent) != "."}
    with tarfile.open(path, "r:gz") as archive:
        members = archive.getmembers()
        files = [m for m in members if m.isfile()]
        require(len(members) == len({m.name for m in members})
                and all(m.isfile() or m.isdir() for m in members)
                and len(files) == len(expected) and {m.name for m in files} == set(expected),
                "Incorrect archive inventory or types")
        for member in members:
            relative = PurePosixPath(member.name)
            require(not relative.is_absolute() and ".." not in relative.parts
                    and str(relative) == member.name and "\\" not in member.name, "Unsafe member path")
            if member.isdir():
                require(member.name in ancestors and member.size == 0, "Unexpected directory header")
                continue
            raw = archive.extractfile(member).read()
            require(identity(raw) == {k: expected[member.name][k] for k in ("bytes", "sha256")},
                    "Changed retained payload")
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        for member in files:
            target = output / member.name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with target.open("xb") as stream:
                stream.write(archive.extractfile(member).read())
    return len(files)
